story:
In a big, bright elementary school, there was a little girl named Soomin. She had many friends in her class, like Emma and Max. Their teacher, Mrs. Thompson, was very kind and helpful. In their classroom, they had a playful pet rabbit named Fluffy. Soomin loved her brand-new lunchbox with pretty, colorful flowers on it. But when it was time for lunch, Soomin's lunchbox was nowhere to be found! "Oh no!" she cried. "My lunchbox is missing!"

Soomin told Mrs. Thompson and her friends about the problem. Emma said, "Don't worry, we can help you find it!" Max added, "We'll look high and low!" They searched under the big, brown tables, behind the tall, green bookshelves, and even inside the cozy, little reading nook. Fluffy hopped around, making soft "twitch, twitch" sounds as if trying to help. As they looked, they found many other lunchboxes - big ones, small ones, red ones, and blue ones. Soomin learned that there were many different kinds of lunchboxes, but none were hers.

After a while, Emma exclaimed, "I think I saw something shiny under the swings outside!" They all ran to the playground, and there, under the swings, was Soomin's lunchbox! It had fallen out of her backpack when she was playing on the swings earlier. Soomin was so happy to have her lunchbox back. She thanked her friends and Mrs. Thompson for their help. "You're all the best!" she said with a big smile. As they sat down to eat, Soomin realized that many lunchboxes were filled with yummy sandwiches, juicy fruits, and crispy crackers - but what made her lunch special was sharing it with her friends.
